properties.name: South work line, LA part
properties.summary: Ville Platte → Eunice → Kinder → Lake Charles → Sulphur → Vinton → Deweyville → Vidor → Evadale → Silsbee. A McDonald’s in most towns; two dead legs (Vinton–Vidor, and nothing after Kountze).

roads: US 171 / Martin Luther King Highway 3 mi

properties.takenNote: RIDDEN 28 Sep - 1 Oct 2026: left the ACA at Ville Platte (mi 492), through Lake Charles and Vinton, rejoins the ACA at Silsbee (mi 650).

properties.name: South work line, TX part
properties.summary: Kountze → FM 770 → Cleveland → Conroe → Montgomery on TX 105. The 2023 flood-detour line other Southern Tier riders used.

roads: West Southline Street / TX 105 Business 22 mi

properties.name: TX 105 variant via Sour Lake
properties.summary: Silsbee → Sour Lake → Batson → Cleveland on TX 105 through the Big Thicket. Shorter, but Sour Lake has one motel and no McDonald’s, and no journals cover this stretch.
